items.rationale: The fixed unit is insured under 4.2.3, and the lightning surge is covered under 2.3.3. At about seven metres from the hob it falls outside the five-metre exclusion, so 7.1.9 allows €1,450 gross for one equivalent replacement, excluding separately billed labour, console and freight.

Section 2.3.10(c) excludes surge damage to climate-control equipment within five metres of the hob. The unit is about two metres away and no kitchen climate endorsement was taken, so the payable amount is €0.
Section 7.1.9(c) covers ordinary removal, fitting, connection and commissioning labour for the covered replacement. Allow about five technician-hours at €95 gross per hour, or €475.
Under 7.1.11, installation labour follows the principal item. The kitchen unit is excluded under 2.3.10(c), so none of its installation charge is payable.
Section 7.1.9(b) covers the equivalent support because the original was scorched and could not be reused. Allow €150 gross for one standard console, with no decorative upgrade under 7.1.10.

Sections 7.1.11–7.1.12 allow only the living-room unit’s share of ordinary freight. Using estimated unit values in the absence of weight-based billing details, €100 gross × €1,450 / (€1,450 + €1,000) gives about €59.
